license_required.quote: A person, partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company shall not, without an active certificate of certified public accountant or a valid registration

issuing_authority.quote: The state board of accountancy is hereby created and consists of seven members appointed by the governor.

name.quote: The state board of accountancy is hereby created and consists of seven members appointed by the governor.

type.quote: The state board of accountancy is hereby created and consists of seven members appointed by the governor.

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Professions and Occupations, Department of Regulatory Agencies
umbrella_agency.quote: There is created a division of professions and occupations in the department of regulatory agencies
umbrella_agency.citation: UMBRELLA / Article 20 - Division of Professions and Occupations (§§ 12-)

degree_required.value: Baccalaureate or higher degree with accounting program approved by the board, plus 150 semester hours of college education
degree_required.quote: Has a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university with an accounting program approved by the board or has a baccalaureate with a nonaccounting concentration supplemented by what the board determines to be the equivalent of an accounting concentration, including related courses in other areas of business administration; and Has completed at least one hundred fifty semester hours of college education approved by the board

accrediting_body.value: Regional accrediting agencies (Middle States, North Central, New England, Northwest Commission, Southern Association, Western Association) or substantially equivalent
accrediting_body.quote: A college or university that is accredited by one of the following regional accrediting agencies or their successor agencies

degree_level.quote: Has a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university with an accounting program approved by the board

school_approval_basis.quote: an accounting program approved by the board

credential_pegged.quote: Has a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by an accredited college or university with an accounting program approved by the board

required.quote: Has one year's experience that: Meets the requirements set by the board by rule; Is in any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills

experience_source.quote: Has one year's experience that: Meets the requirements set by the board by rule; Is in any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills, which may be gained through employment in government, industry, academia, or public practice

duration.quote: Has one year's experience that: Meets the requirements set by the board by rule

kind.value: accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting services
kind.quote: Is in any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills, which may be gained through employment in government, industry, academia, or public practice

exams.name: CPA Examination
exams.notes: Board may use AICPA standard examinations; candidates must meet educational requirements set by board by rule before sitting
exams.quote: The board may use the standard examinations and advisory grading service promulgated by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants, which examination shall be deemed prima facie to meet the requirements of this section.

exams.name: Ethics Examination
exams.notes: Course of study and written examination on professional ethics, from educational institutions or professional organizations approved by the board
exams.quote: Has successfully completed a course of study concerning the subject of professional ethics approved by the board and passed a written examination concerning the subject prepared and given by educational institutions or professional organizations deemed qualified by the board to administer the examination

required.quote: As a condition of renewing, reactivating, or reinstating a certificate of certified public accountant, every applicant shall comply with continuing education requirements adopted by the board.

hours_per_period.quote: the board shall not require continuing education of more than eighty hours every two years

period_years.quote: the board shall not require continuing education of more than eighty hours every two years

available.quote: The board may issue a certificate of certified public accountant to an applicant who satisfies the requirements of the occupational credential portability program.

requirements.value: Applicant must satisfy the requirements of the occupational credential portability program under § 12-20-202(3), including proof of substantially equivalent experience or credentials or holding a valid license in another jurisdiction for at least one year.
requirements.quote: The board may issue a certificate of certified public accountant to an applicant who satisfies the requirements of the occupational credential portability program.

exists.quote: The state board of accountancy is hereby created and consists of seven members appointed by the governor.

national_association.value: American Institute of Certified Public Accountants (AICPA)
national_association.quote: The board may use the standard examinations and advisory grading service promulgated by the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants

regulatory_model.quote: A person, partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company shall not, without an active certificate of certified public accountant or a valid registration: As an independent auditor, make or conduct an investigation, examination, or audit of the financial statements or supporting records of any person, organization, or corporation

credential_type.quote: The board shall grant a certificate of certified public accountant to any applicant who: Passes a written examination pursuant to section 12-100-109; and Meets the requirements of section 12-100-108.

is_mandatory.quote: A person, partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company shall not, without an active certificate of certified public accountant or a valid registration

title_protection.quote: a person shall not assume or use the title or designation "certified public accountant", the abbreviation "C.P.A.", or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card, or device tending to indicate that the person is a certified public accountant unless the person holds a certificate as a certified public accountant issued under this article 100 or under the laws of any other state.

scope_protection.quote: A person, partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company shall not, without an active certificate of certified public accountant or a valid registration: As an independent auditor, make or conduct an investigation, examination, or audit of the financial statements or supporting records of any person, organization, or corporation, to determine the accuracy or fairness with which they present the financial position, changes in financial position, or financial results of operations

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or attempting to obtain a certificate or registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or in attempting to obtain a certificate as a certified public accountant or in obtaining registration under this article 100

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or negligence in the practice of public accounting or in filing/failing to file own income tax returns
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or negligence in the practice of public accounting in Colorado or any other state or in the filing of or failure to file the certified public accountant's own income tax returns

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of the article, applicable article 20 provisions, board rules, or valid agency orders
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of this article 100 or an applicable provision of article 20 of this title 12, of any final rule promulgated by the board, or of any valid agency order

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of a rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a rule of professional conduct promulgated by the board under the authority granted by this article 100

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or crime involving dishonesty or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or of a crime, an element of which is dishonesty or fraud, under the laws of any state or of the United States.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline taken against the person's authority to practice as a CPA or public accountant in any jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline taken against the person's authority to practice as a certified public accountant or a public accountant in any jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline taken against the person's right to practice before any state or federal agency or the PCAOB for improper conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline taken against the person's right to practice before any state or federal agency or agency outside the United States or the public company accounting oversight board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing CPA services to the public for a fee or acting as resident manager without an active certificate or registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Without an active certificate of certified public accountant or a valid registration: Providing certified public accounting services to the public for a fee; or Acting as a resident manager of an entity that is subject to section 12-100-114

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with the requirements for continuing education
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the requirements for continuing education as prescribed by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Act or omission failing to meet generally accepted accounting principles or auditing standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An act or omission that fails to meet generally accepted accounting principles or generally accepted auditing standards in the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, misleading, or deceptive advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of false, misleading, or deceptive advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Substance use disorder or excessive use of habit-forming drug or alcohol that renders the CPA unfit to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A substance use disorder, as defined in section 27-81-102, or an excessive use of a habit-forming drug, controlled substance, as defined in section 18-18-102 (5), or alcohol beverage that renders the certified public accountant unfit to practice public accounting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to retain records of work performed for each client for a period of five years
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to retain records of the work performed for each client for a period of five years

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure of a partnership, professional corporation, or LLC to register with the board and renew the registration
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of a partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company to register with the board pursuant to section 12-100-114 and to renew the registration as prescribed by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices or demonstrated incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices or demonstrated incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility in Colorado, another state, a United States territory, or a foreign country.

insurance_required.quote: The insurance shall insure the partnership, corporation, or limited liability company against liability imposed upon the partnership, corporation, or limited liability company by law for damages resulting from any claim made against the partnership, corporation, or limited liability company arising out of acts, errors, and omissions committed in the performance of professional services

establishment_regulation_required.quote: a partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company engaged in this state in the practice of public accounting as certified public accountants shall register with the board as a partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company of certified public accountants

definition_quote.value: As an independent auditor, make or conduct an investigation, examination, or audit of the financial statements or supporting records of any person, organization, or corporation, to determine the accuracy or fairness with which they present the financial position, changes in financial position, or financial results of operations; or attest or express an opinion, as an independent auditor, as to the financial position, changes in financial position, or financial results of the operation of any person, organization, or corporation, or as to the accuracy or reliability of any financial information contained in any such accounting or financial statement
definition_quote.quote: As an independent auditor, make or conduct an investigation, examination, or audit of the financial statements or supporting records of any person, organization, or corporation, to determine the accuracy or fairness with which they present the financial position, changes in financial position, or financial results of operations of the person, organization, or corporation

methods_authorized.quote: Is in any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills

value: attest opinion on changes in financial position
attest opinion on financial results of operations
attest opinion on accuracy or reliability of financial information
attest_services_types.quote: Attest or express an opinion, as an independent auditor, as to the financial position, changes in financial position, or financial results of the operation of any person, organization, or corporation, or as to the accuracy or reliability of any financial information contained in any such accounting or financial statement

compilation_services_authorized.quote: the board shall not renew the certificate of a holder who issues attest or compilation reports unless the certificate holder performs public accounting within a partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company or the certificate holder has undergone a peer review

education_semester_hours_required.quote: Has completed at least one hundred fifty semester hours of college education approved by the board

ethics_exam_required.quote: Has successfully completed a course of study concerning the subject of professional ethics approved by the board and passed a written examination concerning the subject prepared and given by educational institutions or professional organizations deemed qualified by the board to administer the examination

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: Nothing in this article 100 prohibits a certified public accountant whose principal place of business is located in another state or jurisdiction of the United States from practicing in this state on professional business, as defined by rules promulgated by the board.

value: Subject to jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
Comply with requirements of subsection (2) and board rules
If certificate/license/registration in home state is no longer valid, cease offering or rendering professional services in Colorado
Appoint home-state board as agent for service of process in any action brought by the Colorado board
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: A certified public accountant from another state or jurisdiction of the United States who is practicing in this state pursuant to this subsection (2) and the firm that employs the certified public accountant simultaneously consent, as a condition of practicing in this state: To be subject to the jurisdiction of and disciplinary authority of the board; To comply with the requirements of this subsection (2) and rules promulgated by the board pursuant to this subsection (2); That, if the certified public accountant's certificate, license, or registration issued by the state in which the certified public accountant's principal place of business is located is no longer valid, the certified public accountant will cease to offer or render professional services in this state, either individually or on behalf of a firm; and To appoint the state board or entity that issued a certificate, license, or registration to the certified public accountant as the agent for service of process in any action or proceeding brought by the board against the certified public accountant.

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: the board shall not renew the certificate of a holder who issues attest or compilation reports unless the certificate holder performs public accounting within a partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company or the certificate holder has undergone a peer review

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: A simple majority of the ownership of a certified public accounting firm doing business as a public accounting firm in Colorado, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers, shall be licensed certified public accountants in good standing in this state or another state.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Any other partner, shareholder, or member thereof may, but need not, be a certified public accountant of some state, in good standing, or a registered firm in this state who at all times owns the person's partnership interest, corporate share, or membership interest in the person's own right.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The board shall not renew the registration of a firm that issues attest or compilation reports unless the registered partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company has undergone a peer review conducted according to rules promulgated by the board that meet the standards for performing and reporting on a peer review of the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants or an equivalent standard.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: The holder of a certificate of certified public accountant, upon notice to the board in any form or manner designated by the board, shall have the holder's name transferred to an inactive list and shall not be required to comply with the continuing education requirements for certificate renewal pursuant to section 12-100-115 so long as the holder remains inactive.

retired_license_status_available.quote: Any person who has received from the board and holds a certificate of certified public accountant, including an expired certificate of certified public accountant that remains subject to renewal, reactivation, or reinstatement, may apply to the board for retired status.

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: a foreign partnership, corporation, limited partnership, limited liability partnership, limited liability limited partnership, or limited liability company may engage in the practice of accountancy in this state without registering with the board if the practice is incident to the entity's regular practice outside this state, as defined by the board.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: Each resident manager in charge of an office of the partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company in this state must be a certified public accountant of this state in good standing.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: Nothing in this section shall modify the accountant-client privilege specified in section 13-90-107 (1)(f).

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers, and memoranda made by a certified public accountant incident to or in the course of professional service to a client by the certified public accountant, except financial statements submitted by a certified public accountant to a client and books and records prepared for the use of the client, shall be and remain the property of the certified public accountant in the absence of an express agreement to the contrary between the certified public accountant and the client.

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: Nothing in this article 100 shall prohibit an accountant who holds a certificate, degree, or license in a foreign country, constituting a recognized qualification for the practice of public accounting in the country, from practicing in this state on professional business incident to his or her regular practice outside this state, as defined by the board.

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: In any legal action brought under this article 100, evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this article 100 is sufficient to justify an injunction.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: The board shall not renew the registration of a firm that issues attest or compilation reports unless the registered partnership, professional corporation, or limited liability company has undergone a peer review conducted according to rules promulgated by the board

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: Any person who has received from the board and holds a certificate of certified public accountant, including an expired certificate of certified public accountant that remains subject to renewal, reactivation, or reinstatement, may apply to the board for retired status. The board may grant retired status by issuing a retired status certificate of certified public accountant to any person who meets established conditions prescribed by the board.
